WITH customer_date_range AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date::DATE) as min_date, MAX(txn_date::DATE) as max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT customer_id, unnest(generate_series(min_date, max_date, INTERVAL '1 day')) as txn_date
    FROM customer_date_range
),
transactions_with_amount AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.customer_id,
        ct.txn_date::DATE as txn_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount
            WHEN ct.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -ct.txn_amount
            WHEN ct.txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -ct.txn_amount
            ELSE 0
        END as amount
    FROM customer_transactions ct
),
transactions_per_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, amount FROM transactions_with_amount
),
customer_transactions_with_date AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.customer_id,
        ad.txn_date,
        COALESCE(t.amount, 0) as amount
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN transactions_per_customer t 
        ON ad.customer_id = t.customer_id AND ad.txn_date = t.txn_date
),
with_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        amount,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as running_balance
    FROM customer_transactions_with_date
),
with_max_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        GREATEST(0, running_balance) as daily_balance
    FROM with_balance
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date::DATE) as month,
        MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM with_max_balance
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date::DATE)
),
monthly_total AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(max_daily_balance) as total_max_balances
    FROM monthly_max
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, total_max_balances
FROM monthly_total
ORDER BY month
